desc:
Welcome to Backrooms Evolve!

🧬 Start small and evolve into 67 different entities!
⚔️ Battle other players and earn XP to level up!
⚡ Every entity has its own attacks and a unique skill!
🎲 Roll traits to boost your stats — 28 to find, and some are very rare!
🗺️ Nine paths to climb: of Entities, Clark, Smiler, Soap, Snake, Rat, SCP, Filbus, Animal, and Verity!! 
👁️ The Verity Event takes over the game every 20 minutes — be there before it ends!
📖 Collect every entity to complete your Index!

The CAT HUSS ROOMS event has just begun 😼🎩
